# GAME Small model mirror

This repository includes unmodified official GAME Small v1.0.3 ONNX files in
[`assets/models/game/1.0.3-small/`](../assets/models/game/1.0.3-small/).
Model credit: openvpi/GAME contributors; official release publisher: yqzhishen.

- Source: <https://github.com/openvpi/GAME/releases/tag/v1.0.3>
- Model license declaration: <https://github.com/openvpi/GAME/releases/tag/v1.0.0>
- License: **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**, not the application's MIT license.
- Full license: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode>
- Included license copy: [`GAME-Models-LICENSE`](GAME-Models-LICENSE)
- Hosted mirror: <https://huggingface.co/aaatmy/game-small-onnx>

The original model files and configuration are unchanged. Hikari Tsai added
mirror documentation and SHA-256 checksums. Attribution, noncommercial use and
ShareAlike conditions apply to the model files. Hosting alone does not enable
GAME inference in the application.

The upstream code's MIT license does not replace the separate model license.
